newsitem.title: FRANCE: France gives green light to Carrefour's Cora buy.
newsitem.headline: France gives green light to Carrefour's Cora buy.

text.p: The French Finance, Economy and Industry minister said in a statement on Tuesday that a move by retailer Carrefour to obtain 42.4 percent in a holding company which controls retailer Cora was not against competition rules.

Carrefour recently increased its stake in the GMB holding company to 42.4 percent from 41.4 percent. This stake was acquired in December 1996 for 3.1 billion francs from two groups of family shareholders.
Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said in the statement he would monitor the situation and re-examine his decision when needed.
